# Source-material notices

Preserve the original files and per-file copyright headers. These materials are
not relicensed as a single MIT or Eclipse-only work.

- `EPL-2.0.txt`: original full legal text from ELK v0.9.1.
- `ELK-NOTICE.md`: original full ELK project notice and third-party catalog.
- `elkjs-LICENSE.md`: original full elkjs 0.9.3 license file.
- `EPL-1.0.txt`: full legal text for the EMF-GWT 2.12.4 source headers.
- `Apache-2.0.txt`: full original Apache legal text from Guava v31.1 COPYING.
- `GWT-COPYING.txt`, `GWT-about.txt`: original GWT 2.10.0 distribution notices.

ELK and elkjs sources retain their original contributor/copyright headers.
The PR955 patches retain their upstream authorship and original patch content;
source changes are identified by the ordered patches and manifest, not hidden.

The unchanged EMF common/ecore 2.12.4 source JARs retain IBM and other contributor
copyright headers under EPL-1.0. Xbase/Xtend 2.28.0 source JARs retain their
itemis/other contributor notices under EPL-2.0. Do not replace those versions
with the elkjs wrapper's SPDX label. Xtend sources are included as declared
GWT/build context as well as the identified runtime source set.

GWT 2.10.0 and Guava 31.1-jre source JARs retain individual copyright and license
headers, including any additional per-file terms. They are source/build-context
conveniences; Apache does not generally require source publication merely for
redistributing Apache-licensed executable code.

The preserved ELK project and GWT distribution catalogs describe broader
projects/SDKs. Their retention is not a claim that every listed library or
native component is compiled into the engine. This package is not a complete
native, Nix, compiler-toolchain or all-transitive license audit. No upstream
program or build was executed to assemble these source materials.
